leetcode.description: LeetCode problem data. Consumed by skills/teach-problem (get_problem at S0), skills/daily-drill (get_daily_challenge), and scripts/build-curriculum.py (slug verification). Version is PINNED — an unpinned npx re-resolves on every cold start and a bad upstream release would silently change the tool surface mid-project.

_auth_notes.status: OFF by default. Public tools only.
_auth_notes.how_to_enable: Add "--session", "<your LEETCODE_SESSION cookie>" to the args array above. Get the cookie from browser devtools -> Application -> Cookies -> leetcode.com -> LEETCODE_SESSION.
_auth_notes.what_it_unlocks: get_problem_progress and get_all_submissions — which upgrades 'solved' from self-reported to verified against your real account. See CLAUDE.md > Verification Honesty.
_auth_notes.what_stays_denied: submit_solution and run_code stay denied in .claude/settings.json even with auth on. You submit on leetcode.com yourself. That is not negotiable and not a limitation — it is the product.

_removed.custom_leetcode_server: Considered writing one. Didn't. @jinzcdev/leetcode-mcp-server already wraps LeetCode's GraphQL with exactly the tools this needs, is maintained, and supports auth. Reinventing it would have been the first violation of this project's own premise.
